answer: At registration, a new clone must deposit a plume of 500 tokens and solve a complex challenge to prove their identity. Verification agents, scattered like dunes across the network, validate the solution in real-time. If a clone fails to prove, their tokens are seized and donated to the jetty's reserve. Cloning en masse, a clone risks 10% of their tokens per failed challenge, and with 100 challenges per epoch, the cost can escalate to a 1000-token loss, ensuring the attacker is strictly worse off.
